nativeRegisteredEffectName.scope: Bounded read-only native Media Composer Effect display-name review, extending the immediately preceding Effect Category research. nativeFindings.topic: Recorded effect identity and registered name are separate from the selected master Clip Name
anchors: Previously captured ATrackEffect::ConvertComponentFromAAF7 starts 0x1ece24; OperationGroup interface query 0x1ed01c..0x1ed034, GetMCEffectID call 0x1ed04c.
Component effect-ID assignment 0x1ed128..0x1ed138; registered effect retrieval 0x1ed164..0x1ed178; AEffect::ConvertFromAAF call 0x1ed198.
Previously captured ATrackEffect::GetEffect 0x1f3aac..0x1f3acc passes its own component effect ID to AEffectLibrary::FindEffect.
nativeFindings.conclusion: This is actual effect-component import using its identifier. It is not a native parser of an editable rendered Clip Name. A physical rendered MXF does not automatically prove its original generating effect simply because a related operation or familiar name exists.

anchors: Previously fresh AEffect::SetEffectInfoFromIdentifier 0x7467e0: 0x746890..0x7468a4 selects display name 3D Warp or 3D Warp Legacy according to AlphaFlex; 0x7468bc..0x7468c4 localises that name.
0x7468cc supplies identifier EFF_SBLEND; 0x7468d8 calls SetFundementals with the separate display-name input.
Fresh SetFundementals 0x7464fc saves its display-name argument in x19; version-1 branch 0x746528..0x746558 dispatches ID setter +0x6d0 separately from name setter +0x6f8.
Version-2 branch can transform the identifier spelling, then 0x746734..0x746754 calls those separate setters and supplies the original display-name argument to +0x6f8.
Fresh AEffect vtable bytes map +0x6d0 to SetEffectID 0x75b934 and +0x6f8 to SetName 0x75bb94.
Fresh SetName 0x75bbac..0x75bbc0 applies the native localisation check; 0x75bbc4..0x75bbfc replaces the display-name handle at object +0x98 with its copied string.
Fresh GetName(buffer) 0x75ba6c and GetName(string) 0x75bac0 read that +0x98 name storage.
nativeFindings.conclusion: AEffect has a registered readable effect name separate from its effect identifier and category. This representative registration branch corroborates catalogue provenance. It is not a fresh exhaustive registration audit or proof of live AlphaFlex setting, a particular GUI cell, or universal rendering-name construction.

The earlier receipt establishes the bounded AAF operation-import path. This review does not redo the broader MXF-domain dispatch or establish a complete physical-MXF-to-GUI path. No new evidence establishes the generating effect identity on every selected precompute master.

mdvxReusedFinding.scope: Reuses the 22 October ordinary MXF adapter/table/CSV/filter inspection. No new complete MDVx disassembly, app run or universal library capability claim.
anchors: MDVxMXF addInfoToItem 0x1000326b4..0x100032808 publishes NameInBin, ProjectName, file UID and material UID.

Its four staged ordinary values contain no separate inferred Effect display-name result. Earlier complete row/table/export/filter inspection finds no MediaMuster-style effect-token/catalogue resolver.
mdvxReusedFinding.conclusion: Ordinary MDVx may display effect-looking text inside a raw Clip Name; that is not a separately resolved Effect column or authenticated generating-effect identity.

bellaRecommendation.input: Keep the existing shared name lookup, using final selected Clip Name and independently proven Precompute Type. This is the already agreed MDB Effect contract applied to MXF-supplied names, not a new native-effect-identity reader.
outputRules: Known token or supported localized/compatibility alias: existing first matching canonical English Effect name.
Unrecognised nonempty token: retain extracted token verbatim, including case and underscores.
Empty/unavailable Effect on a Precompute: lowercase unknown at display/export.
Ordinary Media or unknown Type: blank Effect.
bellaRecommendation.integration: Use the same single AvidEffects::Hit as Effect Category, retain Hit.name as an owned shared QString, reuse within selected-master/name processing, and recompute when selected inputs change. Discard legacy Sequence output; Effect Sequence remains excluded.
bellaRecommendation.scope: No new decoder, effect graph traversal, registry/plug-in read, media-header open or permanent per-name cache solely for Effect. General source priorities remain separately agreed. No performance gain is measured.

limits: The native name is established from registration/identifier context, while Bella retains name-derived recognition from editable Clip Names. Those are not claimed equivalent identities.
The fresh check covers a representative built-in registered-name route and setter/getter separation; no full plug-in/name/feature-gate extraction was repeated.
No actual MXF specimen or production resolver output was executed by this agent. Other current-source/wire work owns specimen comparisons.
No universal absence of effect metadata in MXF is claimed, and no original rendering identity or plug-in availability follows from a matched name.

contract.input: Final independently established Type and selected decoded Clip Name. MXF name ownership/UTF-16BE handling already agreed; same qualified master and combined lookup as Effect Category.
contract.recognized: Use AvidEffects::Hit.name: first matching canonical English display name, including recognized localized names and explicit compatibility aliases. Category ambiguity does not change this first-name rule.
contract.unrecognized: Preserve extracted nonempty token verbatim, including uppercase, underscores, whitespace and custom spelling. Do not change it to unknown merely because catalogue recognition fails.
contract.empty: Empty/unavailable Effect on a confirmed Precompute displays/exports lowercase unknown; ordinary Media and Unknown Type display blank.
contract.parsing: Preserve current anchored full suffix validation and precedence for sequence,Effect+N and sequence,Effect,N[.new.N...]. Preserve malformed/overflow numeric text. Keep sequence commas, exact case, localized keys, space/colon mangling of catalogue names and explicit 3DWarp alias. Do not fuzzily normalize unmatched text.
contract.selection: One combined lookup per derivation pass after final Type/name selection; current matching may perform more than one derivation pass. Bella can derive once per selected master/name and reuse associated rows, deriving again if final inputs change.
contract.consumers: Adapter keeps Hit.name as Effect; table, CSV and filter/search display helpers use the same text. No second Effect decoder/resolver is needed.
contract.retention: Bella retains needed Effect and Effect Category owned QStrings, not a separately derived Effect Sequence value or permanent all-name cache. Existing legacy helper still computes Sequence for OldScanner; that is not a Bella retained requirement.
contract.identityLimit: Name-derived label remains an inference from editable text, not proof of original effect ID, execution variant, active plug-in, Type or Precompute Category.
contract.io: No extra header or effect-graph walk required solely for this label. Current absence alone does not request a header; generic unresolved derived-label conflicts can. Broader source/opening priorities are unchanged.

proposedBellaRules.inputs: Final selected independently established Precompute Type and decoded Clip Name from the agreed qualified master. Supported MXF Name decoding already agreed as UTF-16BE.
proposedBellaRules.known: First matching canonical English Effect name from existing shared AvidEffects::lookup, including recognized localized or explicit compatibility aliases.
proposedBellaRules.unrecognized: Nonempty extracted token preserved verbatim, including case, underscores, whitespace and spelling. Unknown Effect Category does not erase Effect text.
proposedBellaRules.unavailable: Empty/unavailable Effect on Precompute displays lowercase unknown. Ordinary Media/unknown Type blank. No change to independent Type or Precompute Category.
proposedBellaRules.parserContract: Preserve exact suffix validation and precedence, sequence commas, malformed/overflow suffix text, case rules, aliases and existing first-name selection for category ambiguity.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Keep owned QString Effect and Effect Category results from the same combined lookup. Reuse associated master/name results during processing, derive again after selected inputs change. Do not retain Effect Sequence or a permanent all-name cache.
proposedBellaRules.readScope: No separate Effect decoder, effect graph, plug-in load or additional source/header read solely for this value. Cross-source priorities remain separate.
proposedBellaRules.identityLimit: Editable-name recognition does not establish the original generating effect identity or live plug-in variant. Native registered names use actual effect-object identifiers.
proposedBellaRules.implementation: Small fresh adapter around existing standalone catalogue/resolver and C++17/Qt6.5.3 values; no measured performance improvement or new framework.
